verdict: Interaction M is reciprocal while effective coupling J is asymmetric when source and receiver factors differ. Because all factors in these models are positive, diag(source/receiver) J is symmetric and has the same zero-threshold sign dynamics as J. The ordinary energy written directly with J is therefore not the appropriate diagnostic: a weighted Lyapunov function exists for this factorized model. Heterogeneity invalidates the naive identification of J as a symmetric weight matrix, but does not by itself rule out attractor dynamics.
note: PAA: many-body screened-Poisson Green's function (double-layer overlap, real geometry). NVPVPE: geometric hydrophobic contact (Paper 2 mechanism). Both: J = diag(receiver)·M·diag(source), M symmetric. Linearized PB (~3% nonlinearity at these low potentials). Not calibrated to data — a physical consistency test.
